interleaved.name: interleaved
interleaved.description: 10 train / 10 test times, alternating (test times 9 and 10 are adjacent)
interleaved.validation: none: nothing is tuned or selected on held-out data (no early stopping)

midpoint.name: midpoint
midpoint.description: 11 train / 9 test times; every test time lies midway between two training times
midpoint.validation: none: nothing is tuned or selected on held-out data (no early stopping)

coarse.name: coarse
coarse.description: 6 train / 14 test times; long gaps between training times
coarse.validation: none: nothing is tuned or selected on held-out data (no early stopping)
